The breakdown of finance income includes dividends received of ¥28,938 million, foreign exchange gains of ¥21,304 million and interest income of ¥14,850 million, and the securities report explains the increase in profit before tax as due to increased finance income associated with the stronger dollar and an increase in share of profit of equity-method investments. The individual table of affiliated companies in the securities report does not list any company whose main business is printed as 'Finance', and the securities report does not show whether such companies are included in 'Other 157 companies'. The history section states that the company began full-scale financial business overseas in May 2023. As of March 31, 2026, the number of consolidated employees in this segment was 1,311 (with 39 temporary employees in addition), the largest headcount among the seven reportable segments.
entries.f3d85a750b2070bc: In May 2023, it put the financial business overseas into full-scale operation.
entries.f6c16ac17320a754: The company group consists of the company, 170 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] and 108 equity-method affiliates, and the company, as a holding company, handles overall management of the group, while its business subsidiaries and affiliates carry out businesses corresponding to 7 [[term:segment|reportable segments]]. The securities report positions its core businesses as businesses that earn 'stock profit' from monthly fees and other payments received after contracts are signed. According to the business risks section of the securities report, product sales are mainly handled by sales agencies, to which commissions based on sales volume are paid, and the cost is mainly recovered through monthly fees and other payments received from customers after contracts are signed.
entries.f6c983ed4b603779: Finance is a reporting segment with revenue from external customers of ¥45,526 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (up 37.4% from the previous fiscal year) and operating profit of ¥22,086 million (up 23.6%), and its number of consolidated employees, 1,311, is the largest among the 7 reporting segments.

entries.f92ceaec8da5d88d: In April 2022, due to the review of the Tokyo Stock Exchange's market segments, it transitioned from the First Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange market to the Prime Market.
